channel.title: Computation on metafunctor
channel.description: Research Engineer & Computer Scientist - Machine Learning, Statistical Computing, Open Source Development

item.title: Numerical Linear Algebra
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Practical matrix computations and numerical realities.

item.title: Gödel, Turing, and the Mathematics of Horror
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: The formal foundations of cosmic dread. Lovecraft's horror resonates because it taps into something mathematically demonstrable: complete knowledge is impossible, not as humility, but as theorem.

item.title: The Mocking Void: On the Computational Incompleteness of Meaning
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Lovecraft understood that complete knowledge is madness. Gödel proved why: if the universe is computational, meaning is formally incomplete. Cosmic horror grounded in incompleteness theorems.

item.title: Noisy Turing Machines: Noisy Logic Gates
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Analyzing how Bernoulli Boolean types propagate through logic circuits, with correctness probabilities for noisy AND gates and interval arithmetic for composed circuits.

item.title: Computational Statistics - SIUe - STAT 575 - Problem Set 2
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell (lex@metafunctor.com)
item.description: This problem set covers the E-M algorithm for right-censored normal data with known variance.

item.title: Review: A Symbolic Representation of Time Series, with Implications for Streaming Algorithms
item.dc:creator: admin
item.description: A review of SAX (Symbolic Aggregate approXimation), a method for converting real-valued time series into symbolic representations with guaranteed distance lower bounds.

item.title: SIUe - Computational Statistics (STAT 575) - Problem Set 4
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: This problem set covers sampling from a Gamma distribution using Metropolis-Hastings and acceptance-rejection methods.

item.title: Suffering, Computation, and the Enigma of Reality
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: If consciousness is substrate-independent, suffering might be a computational property. That possibility is both comforting and horrifying.

item.title: The Call of Asheron: Magic as Computational Discovery
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: A fantasy novel where magic follows computational rules. Natural philosophy applied to reality's underlying substrate.
